“
No time to talk. I have clients to brief, and they're sharp as spoons.
„
— Fentamia Viney

Involvement

Act Three

Fentamia Viney stands in the corner of reception room in the Wyrm's Rock Fortress. She is a lawyer, preparing to present her current case to a Flaming Fist investigator. While waiting, she practices a defensive speech with her clients,  Arborio Rolfin and  Civilian, but from time to time both let slip that they are guilty.

Idle banter

  • Fentamia Viney
    Let's rehearse this one more time. Pretend I'm a Fist, and tell me what you were doing in the house.
  • Civilian
    Well, your Fistliness, we broke down the door because it sounded like somebody was in trouble inside.
  • Arborio Rolfin
    The house was on fire. We were rescuing people.
  • Fentamia Viney
    I spoke to a witness who says you entered the house before the fire started.
  • Civilian
    Who said that? I'll break their bloody legs!
  • Arborio Rolfin
    Err, what my friend means to say is that the witness must have been mistaken. Probably a drunk.
  • Fentamia Viney
    Better. I almost believed you this time.
